Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option A: Tue 11/11, 5:00–5:45pm PT
- Option B: Wed 11/12, 6:00–6:45pm PT

If you can mark preferences in this quick poll it will help (I’ll lock a single bridge + recording): https://doodle.com/poll/8x7y2-demo-slot-pick

Attachments: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (short deck), security-cheat-sheet.pdf (SOC2 highlights). I’ll share one Zoom bridge and send a calendar invite once we pick a slot.

Next steps: please reply with preferred slot or fill the poll by EOD Monday. If you need an alternative timezone, drop a suggested window and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
